name: launchrally
description: Local-first launch readiness audit and verification

scripts.test:contract-core: node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/acceptance-traceability.test.js test/audit-interaction.test.js test/check-catalog.test.js test/contract-v2.test.js test/human-audit.test.js test/init.test.js test/p0-release.test.js test/plan.test.js test/policy-engine.test.js test/prompt-adapters.test.js test/provider-adapters.test.js test/provider-guidance.test.js test/provider-tool-recovery.test.js test/report-destination.test.js test/reporting.test.js test/scaffold.test.js test/system-file-picker.test.js test/verify.test.js
scripts.test:release-contracts: node --test --test-name-pattern="^(?:release validation|release artifact policy|npm release packages|the default first Audit|Codex and Claude marketplaces|native Plugin validators|release docs|release CI|Stable)" test/release.test.js
scripts.test:p1-exact-artifacts: node --test --test-name-pattern="^packed artifacts complete installation, delegation, lifecycle, and full verification journeys$" test/release.test.js
scripts.test:p1-supply-chain: node --test test/phase-1-contracts.test.js test/provider-knowledge.test.js test/reference-packs.test.js test/handoff.test.js test/active-verification.test.js test/phase-1-documentation.test.js
scripts.test:contracts: npm run test:contract-core && npm run test:authority-contracts && npm run test:release-contracts
scripts.test:journeys: npm run test:authority-contracts && node --test test/coverage-acceptance.test.js test/human-audit.test.js test/prompt-adapters.test.js test/reference-journey.test.js test/report-destination.test.js test/system-file-picker.test.js
